# Tally

> Tally is private trade credit on Midnight. Amount stays off the public book. After settle, standing is yes or no only.

Live desk: https://tally-jet-mu.vercel.app
Network: Midnight Preprod
Contract: 84c44946900ca4ad4456518b09a42c01424dd8b626797310c5ed5b4b933b10af
Demo video: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1kvrBCWi8tmJ0JUSjKFEFucGfp7BwmIAZ/view?usp=sharing

## Use Tally

- [Introduction](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/index.mdx): what Tally is and how to start
- [How it works](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/how-it-works.mdx): Offer through Prove standing
- [Privacy](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/privacy.mdx): what the chain shows and what a verifier learns
- [Desk tour](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/desk-tour.mdx): Local vs Preprod, roles, screenshots
- [Local quickstart](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/quickstart.mdx): full path in about ten minutes, no wallet
- [Preprod guide](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/preprod.mdx): Lace or 1AM on the test network
- [Demo video](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/demo.mdx): Drive recording of the desk
